This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>danmar/cppcheck (https://github.com/danmar/cppcheck.git)</summary>

### [`v2.22.0`](https://redirect.github.com/cppcheck-opensource/cppcheck/releases/tag/2.22.0): cppcheck 2.22.0

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/compare/2.21.1...2.22.0)

Release Notes for Cppcheck 2.22

Major bug fixes & crashes:

-   Fixed a large number of fuzzer-found crashes and hangs in the tokenizer and template simplifier, e.g. TemplateSimplifier::expandTemplate() ([`bb630c2`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/bb630c244), [`3f2d60c`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/3f2d60c4b)), Tokenizer::simplifyTypedef() ([`71de675`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/71de6753d), [`3deb36d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/3deb36d1f), [`592e7b7`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/592e7b7c2)), Tokenizer::simplifyUsing() ([`9162aa7`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/9162aa7fb), [`7d5a54c`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/7d5a54cc6)), Tokenizer::findGarbageCode() ([`08db304`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/08db3048d)) and ReverseTraversal::traverse() ([`3a3184d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/3a3184de2), [`5aa31d0`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/5aa31d0da)).
-   [`6d2b6f4`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/6d2b6f4a5) Fix [#​14974](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14974) \[regression] inline suppression does not work with build dir anymore.
-   [`9a500c8`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/9a500c866) Fix [#​14972](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14972) \[regression] Syntax Error: AST broken, '!' doesn't have an operand.

New checks:

-   [`0d7884d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/0d7884dad) Warn when feof() is used as a while loop condition (wrongfeofUsage).
-   [`04091bd`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/04091bd59) ftell() result is unspecified when file is opened in mode "t".
-   [`3d88880`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/3d88880e8) Detect when an STL algorithm such as std::copy, std::equal, std::transform, etc. accesses more elements through an iterator than are available in the container (algorithmOutOfBounds).
-   [`f695ade`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/f695ade7f) Detect switch cases that cannot be selected when the switch condition has a known value (unreachableSwitchCase).

C/C++ support:

-   [`b878dc2`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/b878dc223) Support C++23 'if consteval' / 'if !consteval'.
-   [`7a8c67a`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/7a8c67ab4) Fix [#​15007](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/15007) `isAttributeNoreturn` not set for `_Noreturn`.

GUI:

-   [`f81f6f0`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/f81f6f0e7) Fix [#​14829](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14829) Platform configuration mismatch between UI selection and analysis log.
-   [`9f74c2d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/9f74c2db8) Fix [#​14813](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14813) crash: recheck in GUI sometimes crashes.
-   [`550189b`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/550189be6) Fix [#​14738](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14738) GUI recheck of files not working properly when importing compile_commands.json.
-   [`8f7666d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/8f7666dd3) Fix [#​14983](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14983) GUI: exclude file with relative path.
-   [`6640862`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/6640862c9) Fix [#​14933](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14933) each GUI log entry line should be output on a separate line.
-   [`5799d47`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/5799d47ee) Removed GUI compliance report instructions (feature removed).

Suppressions:

-   [`93546a2`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/93546a2bc) XML suppression file: added macro attribute for specifying macro name.
-   [`fecb349`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/fecb3496f) Fix [#​14959](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14959) Warning hash for token-based warnings.
-   [`f6fff71`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/f6fff71c1) Fix [#​15013](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/15013) Calculate warning hash for CTU warnings.
-   [`0b59984`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/0b5998407) Baseline functionality (script and documentation).
-   [`637d5be`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/637d5be67) Suppression file name cache. (performance)
-   [`c976cac`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/c976cac0e) ErrorLogger: do not open and read from files unless necessary (performance).

Import project:

-   [`d32c01d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/d32c01d1b) Added support for Folders in slnx project files, skip non-C++ projects.
-   [`9408a1d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/9408a1d22) Added support for vcxproj ExcludedFromBuild.
-   [`bf099d1`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/bf099d1d1) Import project: handle forced include files from compilation database projects.
-   [`3a9750e`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/3a9750e31) Flexible handling of -isystem, --sysroot and -I flags in compile_commands.json through the script tweak-compile_commands.py.

Infrastructure & dependencies:

-   [`4e62f0c`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/4e62f0cca) Fix [#​14614](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14614) Optionally provide comments in preprocessor output (BuildCache).
-   [`ff4d7ce`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/ff4d7ce36) Fix [#​14987](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/issues/14987) Update simplecpp to 1.9.1.

Other:

-   [`1fb6630`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/1fb66305f) Added configuration file for Microsoft.GSL (Guideline Support Library).
-   [`167f49d`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/167f49dce), [`5aec67c`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/5aec67c33), [`767ace6`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/commit/767ace640) man/checkers: documented remaining checkers and fixed guideline classifications for MISRA C++.

### [`v2.21.1`](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/compare/2.21.0...2.21.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/compare/2.21.0...2.21.1)

### [`v2.21.0`](https://redirect.github.com/cppcheck-opensource/cppcheck/releases/tag/2.21.0): Cppcheck-2.21.0

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/danmar/cppcheck/compare/2.20.1...2.21.0)

Release Notes for Cppcheck 2.21

Major bug fixes & crashes:

-   Fixed potential crash with incomplete preprocessor directive
-   Fixed hang in createAst
-   Fixed invalid AST for braced initialization and references/pointers
-   Fixed cppcheckError with array typedef
-   Fixed recheck which now correctly excludes non selected files
-   Fixed potential crash when rechecking files in gui

New checks:

-   MISRA C 2012 rule 10.3 now warns on assigning integer literals 0 and 1 to bool in C99 and later while preserving the existing C89 behavior.
-   funcArgNamesDifferentUnnamed warns on function declarations/definitions where a parameter in either location is unnamed
-   uninitMemberVarNoCtor warns on user-defined types where (1) some but not all members requiring initialization have in-class initializers or (2) there is a mixture of members which do/do not require initialization.
-   fcloseInLoopCondition warns when fclose() is used as a while loop condition, which may skip the loop body or double-close the file handle.

C/C++ support:

-   import project: include path in compile_commands.json now handled correctly

GUI:

-   Removed handling of Cppcheck Premium LOC license

Other:

-   Make it possible to specify the regular expression engine using the `engine` element in a rule XML.
-   Added CLI option `--exitcode-suppress` to specify an error ID which should not result in a non-zero exitcode.
-   Moved source code from https://github.com/danmar/cppcheck to https://github.com/cppcheck-opensource/cppcheck
-   The official Windows binary is now built with Visual Studio 2026.
-   Updated simplecpp to 1.7.0.
